app.lander.hero.lede: is an opinionated fork of OpenCode that talks to the internal LLM gateway instead of upstream providers. Same agent, same workflows — your keys, your usage caps, your audit log.

app.lander.steps.title: From install to first prompt.
app.lander.steps.lede: Four commands, no manual config, no API keys to manage. The gateway handles auth on the first invocation.
app.lander.steps.01.title: Grab the binary
app.lander.steps.01.desc: Homebrew on macOS, apt on Debian, or a single binary download for everything else.
app.lander.steps.02.title: Sign in to the gateway
app.lander.steps.02.desc: Opens your browser, hands you back to the terminal. Token lives in the system keychain.
app.lander.steps.03.title: Add the tools you need
app.lander.steps.03.desc: Pull in filesystem, GitHub, and anything else your work touches — one command each.
app.lander.steps.04.title: Open a session
app.lander.steps.04.desc: Drop into the TUI from any project directory. mage reads your repo, indexes it, and waits.
